scope:
Seeded tiny native smoke and consteval-placement control, not model performance.

Uses the shared two-block nonzero-LoRA test fixture. Separate processes for
dynamic and fixed conditioning; all branch outputs and policy metadata retained.
finding: Tiny two-block frozen conditioning preserves both CPU branches bitwise and all learned parameter identities/values. Native main conditioning products fall6to0 (total main linear/matmul37to31). Runtime IR places both KV and projection caches in CPU-hoisted consteval setup. Both original branches and changed-noise output pass smoke, repeat exactly and cause no fallback/recompile. Frozen tiny resident calls are slower than dynamic; no speedup or pretrained-scene quality claim.
